newsitem.title: FRANCE: Moslem rebels killed 47 in Algerian massacres-paper. [CORRECTED 07:58 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Moslem rebels killed 47 in Algerian massacres-paper. [CORRECTED 07:58 GMT]

text.p: Suspected Moslem fundamentalists killed 47 people in two attacks on villages south of the Algerian capital overnight on Sunday-Monday, (corrects time period from Monday-Tuesday) an Algerian newspaper said on Wednesday.
Le Matin said 38 died in one attack and and nine in another. Most were killed by having their throats cut.
